title: E-Paper
intro: Put fleet token usage on the Bluetooth e-paper display on your desk.
introRefresh: Put fleet token usage on the Bluetooth e-paper display on your desk. One refresh takes about 20 seconds and the panel runs on a battery, so do not set it too often.

device.title: Device
device.notFound: No e-paper found. Make sure it is not connected to a phone and is within a few metres.
device.alias: Fallback name (matches by name when the address is empty)

content.title: Displayed content
content.headline: Today's token headline
content.cost: Cloud price conversion (CNY; rates are configured under Settings → Cloud price)
content.pigment: Accent colour (yellow or red depends on the panel)
content.footerText: Footer text (blank uses the default; the refresh-time token is filled in automatically)
content.protectAuto: Smart: outline small text tightly, large text with a single ring
content.protectHalo: Outline all text (leave the background untouched)
content.protectPlate: Leave a blank plate behind text
content.protectOff: None (the background may cut through glyphs)

preview.title: Preview
preview.unsaved: The form has unsaved changes; the panel still shows the last pushed frame
preview.none: No preview yet. Check that eink-bridge is running on the host.

notice.pushed: Pushed to the e-paper (dither: {{algorithm}}), took {{seconds}} s

pricing.name: Name
pricing.sync: Sync prices from the official site
pricing.synced: Prices synced from the DeepSeek website
